summary: One quick Phase 1 pass, as requested. Backend: 2 of 2 pytest tests passed. They cover the 10 likes/day limit (the 11th returns 429 with daily_like_limit_reached), unlimited passes, 3 rewarded +5s (likes_remaining=15) with the 4th returning 429 rewarded_ad_limit_reached, and premium likes being unlimited. Frontend, mobile 390px, free.male: counter showed '10 likes left' and dropped by 1 per like down to 0. The next like opened out-of-likes-modal with the watch-ad and go-premium buttons. The simulated reward set the counter to 5 and closed the modal. Once all 3 rewards were used, the modal showed only the premium button. Pass-btn still worked at 0 likes. /chat/<match_id> with Test Girl 1 opened with no unlock gate, and the message sent (POST /api/messages 200) and showed up. premium.male: no likes-left-counter.

minor.issue: These endpoints have no auth check. Any client can call the reward endpoint or spend likes for any user_id. The reward is also granted on a client call alone, with no server-side ad verification (AdMob SSV).

integration_issues.issue: No sonner toast was found about 5s after the reward, but it may have closed before the check. The counter update to 5 is confirmed. Not verified.

issues: After about 11 matches, the 'Enjoying HeartLink? Rate on Play Store' popup appears in the middle of swiping and on Matches, covering the out-of-likes modal. Not part of Phase 1, but it interrupts the flow.

action_items: Optional: add auth checks (and ideally AdMob server-side verification) to the like-quota reward and action endpoints
Optional: stop the rate-app popup from showing on top of the out-of-likes modal
critical_code_review_comments: The /like-quota endpoints trust the user_id in the path, with no auth.
seed_data_creation: Ran seed_phase1.py (idempotent). Created like/pass records from free.male and premium.male to seeded girls and AI profiles, plus one message 'TEST_hello from free user' in match 08521c87-5c3d-4760-b31f-7356efca788a. Reset free.male's like counters to 0 at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login on the web: POST /api/auth/login with {email_or_phone, password}, then set localStorage 'user' to the response's user. Set 'heartlink_daily_reward_date' to today to skip the daily reward modal. Close the match animation with match-keep-discovering-btn. The route is /auth, not /login. Test Girl 1 was not easy to find on the Matches list because of many AI matches, so I opened the chat directly by match id.
